# Microsoft Open Specifications (RDP)

The documents in this directory are Microsoft Open Specifications
documentation, © Microsoft Corporation. They are **not** covered by this
project's MIT / Apache-2.0 license.

They are reproduced, converted from the published DOCX to Markdown, as
implementation references for this RDP client, under the terms of the
"Intellectual Property Rights Notice for Open Specifications Documentation"
kept verbatim at the top of each `document.md`. Patent terms are those of the
Microsoft Open Specifications Promise / Community Promise named in that
notice.

Canonical versions: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/
(e.g. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-rdpbcgr/).

To regenerate from the originals: `vendor/get-specs.sh`, then
`vendor/render-specs.sh`.
